name: nuget-validate
description: Validate NuGet package versions for vulnerabilities, deprecation, listing status, and freshness.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only plugin that checks NuGet package versions for vulnerabilities, deprecation, listing status, and stale releases before package changes.
defaultPrompt: Validate this NuGet package version before I add it.
